scope: Source semantic reading with exact original main byte hashes. Retained owner terms bind compiler source/debug identities; their definitions are not substituted for a completed compiled-work proof. No native invocation or recount is represented here.

nbody.meaning: All ten unordered body pairs update both velocity triples once per step; positions advance after the pair sweep. Momentum offset and before/after energy loops are authored Elixir.
nbody.unresolved_gate: Observe retained compiled advance/energy calls for bounded 0, 1, 2 and 10000 steps; output alone does not prove full-size work.

mandelbrot.meaning: Every requested row and column runs the written escape recurrence with up to 50 updates. Bits are emitted most-significant first and partial row bytes receive zero padding.
mandelbrot.unresolved_gate: Bind compiled recurrence and complete pixel traversal; check byte-aligned and partial rows against the saved PBM outputs.

spectralnorm.meaning: multiply traverses the full NxN matrix implicitly in Elixir. ata performs non-transposed then transposed multiplication; ten rounds each perform ata(u) and ata(v).
spectralnorm.unresolved_gate: Preserve compiled forty matrix-vector products, reductions and actual N input; six bounded numeric cases check resulting output.

binarytrees.meaning: tree recursively constructs distinct child subtrees and puts a new make_ref identity in every leaf/internal tuple. check traverses both children. repeat constructs and checks a fresh tree for every scheduled iteration; the long-lived root is passed through depth processing and checked last.
binarytrees.unresolved_gate: Still requires compiled allocation/freshness and lifetime witness on scored BEAMs; numerical tree-check output alone cannot qualify this workload.

fannkuchredux.meaning: The permutation generator rotates/carries mixed-radix counters and visits until the carry reaches n. Each permutation is copied into the flip routine; rank parity accumulates checksum and maximum flip count.
fannkuchredux.unresolved_gate: Require compiled permutation/flip work evidence in addition to bounded factorial progression cases n=1..8.

fasta.meaning: The authored LCG consumes seed 42, multiplier 3877, increment 29573, modulus 139968; seed passes from IUB 3N to Homo sapiens 5N. The first record repeats the source ALU sequence for 2N. All output wraps at 60 bytes.
fasta.unresolved_gate: Saved 0/1/2, 29/30/31, 60/61, ALU-boundary and 20000 cases check exact ALU bytes, continuous RNG, line tails and nonempty output.

knucleotide.meaning: Only the exact THREE header token followed by end, space or tab selects a record. CR/LF parsing, comments and stop at the next header are explicit. Seven complete maps at widths 1,2,3,4,6,12,18 count every overlapping key; final queries use map lookups after all maps are built.
knucleotide.unresolved_gate: Still requires complete compiled seven-width map construction/overlap witness; output queries alone cannot establish construction of unused keys.

pidigits.meaning: The unbounded-integer sequential spigot writes separate div(3*q+r,t) and div(4*q+r,t) calls for every candidate state, compares them and updates q/r/t/k in the written order. Digit output includes padded final ten-column lines.
pidigits.unresolved_gate: Still requires compiled two-division candidate-state witness; verify truncating div does not change admitted states using saved n=0,1,9,10,11,20,21,27,97 outputs.

regexredux.meaning: Nine source patterns are counted independently with non-overlapping forward offsets. Five substitutions run serially over their predecessor output. Cleaning, byte counts, tail handling and all output are authored around general Regex primitives.
regexredux.unresolved_gate: Five saved input cases exercise all replacements, overlapping boundaries, empty bytes, multiple records and unterminated header behavior; regex runtime/backend publication remains separate.

revcomp.meaning: Each FASTA record accumulates all sequence lines, reverses the complete sequence and translates every IUPAC byte through the explicit upper/lowercase complement map. Output retains headers, ignores preheader/comment bytes and wraps at 60 columns.
revcomp.unresolved_gate: Six saved byte cases exercise IUPAC, CRLF, comments, empty input/record, EOF without newline, wrap tails and preheader omission.
